description:
Explore verification sessions (admin-only)

Admin only. Search verification sessions across all organizations — filter by `sessionId` (prefix match, at least 5 characters), `providerId` (id or slug), `claimantClientId`, `orgId` (all exact match), `status`, and a `createdAfter`/`createdBefore` time range. Rows link to the org-scoped session detail page (admins can open any org's pages). Newest first, 50 per page, with opaque cursor pagination.

status.description:
Status of a verification session, derived from its events. New values
may be added over time; clients MUST tolerate unknown values in
responses.

- `pending`: Created, not yet finished; completable until `expiresAt`.

- `success`: Terminal — `verification_success` recorded.

- `rejected`: Terminal — `verification_rejected` recorded.

- `error`: Terminal — `verification_error` recorded.

- `cancelled`: Terminal — `verification_cancelled` recorded.

- `expired`: `expiresAt` passed before a terminal event; the end-user
  can no longer complete it.

verificationClientId.description: A verification client id used as a filter. Hyphens are ignored.

name: admin_sessions
